Question 4
?

A particle P moves along the x-axis. When the displacement of P from the origin O is x meters, its velocity is vm/s and its acceleration is 2x4m/s2. Which differential equation describes this motion?

a
ddx(2v2)=2x4
b
ddx(12v2)=2x4
c
ddx(14v2)=2x4
d
ddx(v3)=2x4
e
ddx(13v3)=2x4
